title: Input Symbol in an Extractor Configuration
statement: Let $x$ and $a$ be Boolean words, let $q$ be an optional state in $\operatorname{Option}(\mathbb{B}\oplus\mathrm{Fin}(3))$, let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\le |x|$, and let $z\in\mathbb{Z}$ and $out$ be a Boolean word. In the configuration with input head at position $i+1$, work tape storing $a$, work-tape head at $z$, state $q$, and output $out$, the scanned input symbol is the $i$th symbol of $x$, or no symbol if $i$ is beyond its end.
hypotheses_covered: q is an optional state in Option (Bool ⊕ Fin 3)
i is a natural number with i≤|x|
a and out are Boolean words
